<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—M+1 ≈9 % and M+2 ≈0.6 % of the base peak—the distribution matches the natural carbon isotopic envelope (≈1.1 % per carbon for M+1, decreasing rapidly for higher isotopes). No other element shows a characteristic pattern of this magnitude (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
